name: Dageno AI
summary: GEO platform that shows how AI systems represent your brand, then helps you fix visibility gaps with agents.
description: Dageno AI is a generative-engine-optimization data and agent platform. It combines signals from your site, traffic, prompts, social and mentions to show why AI systems recommend competitors, and it can run agent-powered fixes and track progress. The site also offers free AI visibility tools and a free SEO/GEO/AEO report. Product Hunt’s 2.0 launch noted a free trial with no credit card.

pricing.details: Free tools and report; Starter 44 €/month, Growth 178 €/month, Scale 366 €/month.

features: gap analysis across content and sources
